headline: Realmuto's two-out single in 9th walks off Mets
recap: Tied 1-1 entering the bottom of the ninth, the Phillies walked it off against Mets closer Edwin Diaz. Bryce Harper struck out to open the inning, Nick Castellanos singled and stole second, and after Alec Bohm struck out swinging, J.T. Realmuto lined a two-out single to center to send Castellanos home for a 2-1 win.

Cristopher Sanchez and David Peterson matched zeros for seven innings before both starters gave up a run in the eighth. Tyrone Taylor led off the top of the eighth with a solo home run off Sanchez, and the Phillies answered right back in the bottom half when Weston Wilson doubled leading off and scored on Buddy Kennedy's double off Peterson.

Orion Kerkering relieved Sanchez in the eighth and struck out two before a single put runners on the corners, then retired Brandon Nimmo on a groundout to end the inning without further damage. Jose Ruiz followed with a perfect top of the ninth, striking out one, to pick up the win after Diaz took the loss.
